Base cycles lift to cycles, including parallel edges. Exactly the same criterion characterizes forests in the apex graph G_m. Barycentric edge-orbit substitution gives the geometric fixed-space PL isomorphism, not merely invariant vertices. Graphic-matroid independence-shellability and the Cayley labeled-tree exponential formula give homotopy and coefficients. Independently enumerated multigraph forests for m=1..4, recovering top Betti 0,2,24,396, and inspected exhaustive original-orbit union-find verifier for m<=4; general proof is combinatorial, not finite inference.
